appearance.extreme: Two great domed compound eyes take up most of their face, a thousand facets each, and there's nowhere in the room they aren't looking.
appearance.obvious: Their eyes have gone to clustered facets, dark and geometric, and they track you without turning their head.
appearance.subtle: Their eyes catch the light in too many places at once.

description: Your eyes have divided into clustered facets. You see almost everything at once, and none of it the way you used to.
drawbacks: People can't hold eye contact with you
name: Compound Eyes
